\par\smallskip\raggedright
\textit{Note.} Error magnitude = hypot(along, cross) at each time after the flow-loss point; UKF and FGO baselines (no heading), 11 flights each (blank floor, pooled across Experiments 1A and 1B: the standard-sensor dataset (1A), the camera calibration flights and both camera datasets (1B)). \textdagger{} runaway magnitudes: evidence of divergence with its order of magnitude, not bit-reproducible values.\par
\textit{Note.} EKF3 'invalid': on all 14 blank flights there are 0 valid airborne flow frames in the cruise, so flow aiding never starts; EKF3 flags its position invalid from take-off (301--310 s of cruise) and outputs exactly the origin, which is not scored (evaluation rule). This is a declared failure, not a small error.\par
\textit{Note.} With the camera heading the yaw is held but position still is not (+60 s: UKF 21--71 m, FGO 130--172 m \textdagger{}; quoted from the results record (numbers.md erratum E8), not re-derived here). Descriptive only (no registered rule uses it): the UKF heading arm is below its own baseline at +60 s on 6 of 6 blank camera flights (margin 0.6--17.5 m), the FGO on 5 of 6. Three of the six are plain-wall flights over the blank floor, where the heading PASSED the heading-measurement validation (3/3, numbers.md \S{}6.6); position is not bounded on any.\par
\textit{Note.} Ordering verdicts used in the footnotes: RULE MET = a pre-registered rule was applied and met, so its ordering (or similarity) is claimed; case (i) TEST RUN, RULE NOT MET = a pre-registered decision rule with a 'no ordering' outcome was applied and gave that outcome; case (ii) FAILED AS WORDED = a pre-registered prediction of an ordering or a similarity was scored literally and is false, which does not by itself establish the opposite ordering; case (iii) NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED = values are descriptive. n always names its unit (flights, bags, losses).\par
\textit{Note.} [a] Ordering basis, blank floor (no flow aiding), all three estimators. Metric: error magnitude hypot(along, cross) after the flow-loss point, m, and EKF3's invalid period, s of cruise. n = 11 flights for the UKF and the FGO (both replayed on the same 11 blank-floor bags) and 14 flights for EKF3 (all blank-floor flights, Experiments 1A and 1B pooled). Rule: none: the blank floor is ruled 'Not accuracy comparisons'; no comparative test was pre-registered. Result: no estimator bounds position (UKF and FGO runaways, EKF3 position invalid), so no ordering is formed. Verdict: case (iii), NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED: values are descriptive.\par
